notes.title: The Free Playtest for Re: Spin Die Repeat Starts Now!
notes.content: [h2]Welcome, traveller, to your Isekai adventure!  [/h2][p]What? How did you end up here? An amusing question, for it seems the trope is real; you worked yourself to death, literally!  [/p][p]But worry not, for you have another chance. When you next open your eyes, you will not be in your office, nor your bed, but in a different world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499107/720b82e9abd58c92278c5f781df177a37fca76af.png"][/img][/p][p]This world is ruled by a dark goddess, one created by a previous traveller, much like yourself, and now you need to save it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499107/efb2430bd8514c540615aa65bf80fca821fea0c7.png"][/img][/p][p]You won't be armed with swords and elemental magic, but instead, you have a slot machine. Unique as it may sound, this is a powerful artefact, for every spin will decide your survival, and your fate. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499107/4967c14615266764d5f5655a2207ea4d7dab879a.png"][/img][/p][p]The world of Re: Spin Die Repeat opens (change as needed: today / on the 22nd of September) and there you will find:  [/p][list][*][p][b]2 Story Volumes:[/b] With about 70 minutes of quests and narration [/p][/*][*][p][b]1 Random Scenario:[/b] With plenty of replayable chaos [/p][/*][*][p][b]80 Symbols:[/b] Collect and Spin them [/p][/*][*][p][b]20+ Items:[/b] Use them to bend luck in your favor [/p][/*][*][p][b]10+ Followers:[/b] Who will join your journey [/p][/*][*][p][b]3 Skills:[/b] Early-game abilities to experiment with[/p][/*][/list][h3]Difficulty Modes: [/h3][list][*][p]Story Mode: retry-friendly, enjoy the tale [/p][/*][*][p]Roguelike Mode: permadeath, no mercy  [/p][/*][/list][p]Please remember, this is a playtest and we really need your feedback. After playing, let us know what you think of our chaotic world, whether you like it or not, and your reasoning. All of your feedback will help us build the game further![/p]

notes.title: The page is live! Long live the page!
notes.content:
We are happy to finally go live with our page and can't wait to share our first builds with the players.
The game is still in development, and we have a lot of things to do, but we are working hard to deliver a first demo next month!

Before the official demo release, we will be glad to welcome players to the playtest!
This will be tough, but if you love isekai anime or roguelike games, we are sure you will enjoy the game.


[h2]Okay, but what's it about?[/h2]
You met your destiny—unfortunately, it was bad luck. But now, you are a demigod in a fantasy world who controls destiny with the power of... a slot machine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499107/0d72355521312a9f27656ee65902cd1aa5fe4a5f.gif[/img]

[h2]Are you wondering what you could achieve with such power?[/h2]
Well, with great power comes... trivial goals! For the tutorial of the game when you play for the first time, you will engage in such glorious and terrific tasks as:

[h3][b]Milking the cows![/b][/h3]
